# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Age:** 18 years old during her Freshman year; 20 years old by her Senior year  <sub>[v3 c4 P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 c19 P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P24](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c38 P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida is an exceptionally attractive young woman with shiny, nut-brown hair, dark black eyebrows, and large, plush, dark-brown eyes. She has an uneven, asymmetrical mouth with tiny white teeth, rosy cheeks, and charming dimples. She dresses with extreme elegance and style, often wearing fine silks, ribbons, and elaborate hats.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c26 P7](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0007), [v3 c33 P7](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0007)_

## Personality

Cressida is lively, open, and intensely dramatic, possessing a strong, lighthearted humor that brightens those around her. Though she acts delightfully foolish, superficial, and indecisive on the surface, she is inherently unselfish, loyal, and warm-hearted. She loves being surrounded by admirers, yet she remains free of true conceit and is deeply appreciative of her friends.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P24](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0024), [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c4 P40](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0040), [v3 c20 P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007), [v3 c34 P14](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0014)_

- Obtain a Bachelor of Arts degree at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c4 P53](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0053), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)</sub>

## History

After attending Regent's Academy, Cressida enrolled at Wexcombe College to pursue her Bachelor of Arts degree. In her Freshman year, she befriended Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis in Old St. John's Cemetery, introducing them into her social circle. In her Sophomore year, she moved into Tabby's Place alongside Nell, Honora, and Mabel Colby, where she learned domestic duties under Aunt Euphemia's care. During a summer break at Prospect Point, she met Ezra Hale, an impoverished theology student. Despite her previous insistence on marrying for wealth, she fell deeply in love with Ezra, ultimately accepting his proposal of marriage and agreeing to join him in his mission work on Tanner Street after graduation. She graduated from Wexcombe College with Honors in Mathematics.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P0](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0000), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c10 P14](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0014), [v3 c10 P54](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0054), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)_

## Quotes

> If it is not a bother, please assure me frequently that I am attractive. Believing that I am attractive makes me feel far more at ease.  <sub>[v3 c4 P40](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0040)</sub>

> There is the difference. You know, I don't care even a little about any of them. ... But Ezra ... Ezra matters, and my love belongs to him, Nell.  <sub>[v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017)</sub>

> You see, my thoughts had been racing. It was clear to me that I had to make my own choice, and doing so proved quite simple once I knew my own mind. Experiencing such certainty feels wonderful, especially realizing that this conviction belongs to you rather than another person.  <sub>[v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)</sub>

> In the banquet of life, humor serves as the most zesty seasoning. > The way I have been wealthy is how cheerfully I will be poor. You will witness it. Learning to cook and altering dresses is what I intend to do.  <sub>[v3 c27 P28](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0028)</sub>
